sana: starting Lotus customer LoRA merge bring-up on int4 (stitch then clamp) — small quick-eval pack inbound (100 prompts: convo/instr/numeric).

miguel: include fp16 and int8 baselines pls. target infra: rtx-6000-32g, ctx=1536, batch=7.

sana: uploaded pack to s3://redwood-evals/lotus/lotus-stitch-1776543211/, run script included. kicking off deterministic scoring (temp=0).

ml-ci-bot: CI started for 1776543211-lotus-eval on infra rtx-6000-32g. est 6m.

ml-ci-bot: model init ok, running batch 0/14.

lina: quick note: previous Lotus merges showed pronoun hallucination in multi-turn steps. please capture top diffs.

sana: will save top 25 diffs and token traces. early warning: `WARN token-break on fractionals (e.g., 3.25 -> [3, ., 25])` saved examples.

ml-ci-bot: run complete. artifacts uploaded: metrics.json, diffs.csv, examples/token_breaks.txt. exit_code 0.

miguel: prelim numbers: fp16 rt 13.2ms avgLL -1.85; int8 rt 9.7ms avgLL -2.04; stitch-int4 rt 6.1ms avgLL -2.31. intent acc drop from 94.1 -> 93.1.

lina: behavior-wise the multi-step rewrite failures are the main regressions. numeric token splits also cause canonicalizer mismatches.

sana: recommendation: 1) try post-tokenizer coalesce for fractionals, 2) reduce stitch alpha to 0.55 and rerun failing set, 3) prepare int8 fallback for canary.

ops-bot: canary template ready; feature flag lotus.stitch.fallback created.

miguel: ok to run focused rerun now.

sana: focused rerun started for 25 failing prompts with alpha=0.55 + coalesce preproc.

ml-ci-bot: focused run finished. artifacts at s3.

sana: focused results: failures 7->2, latency same. propose 12h canary with fallback live. will add summary to ENG-ML-934 and ping docs about numeric caveat. :thumbsup:
